text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp starts today! As for 
Shinko Windy...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This is huge! Windy-chan is trending on 
Umatter!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't everyone be talking about how 
strong Windy-chan is by now...! Let's see 
here, let's see...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I checked on my smartphone too. However...

text_block_list.name: Umatter
text_block_list.text:
"【News】 The "Lion Dance Festival" is 
making waves! Children cheer in delight as 
their heads are "bitten" for good luck to 
ward off evil."

text_block_list.name: Umatter
text_block_list.text:
—Is that Windy-san? —Reminds me of Shinko 
Windy. —Lion Dance: "I just wanted to 
play!"

text_block_list.name: Umatter
text_block_list.text:
—Now all I see is Windy-chan. Biting like 
that is so cute. #LionDanceFestival 
#ShinkoWindy

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan... had nothing to do with it, 
right?! Why am I... being made fun of like 
this?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grrr...! This isn't what I wanted to 
heaaar~! Say something more like 'strong' 
or 'scary' dammittt!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An "internet meme"... is it? It seems I 
have completely become a meme character.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet she brought this upon herself. The 
criticism and mockery are seeds she sowed 
on her own. Given the current situation, 
there's only one thing left to do.
choice_data_list: Let's focus on the training camp for now.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Indeed... There is no other way.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I'll get stronger so I can shut them all 
up in our next race!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Boarding the bus. The one who ended up 
sitting next to her was...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! Hand over the window seat to 
Windy-chan-nanoda~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Biko?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, right... Sorry, I was spacing out 
a bit."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...? What's the matteeeer?! Does your 
tummy hurt...!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"No... I was just thinking about my 
previous race..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Man... I've been losing so many in a 
row... I make the board, so I should be 
just this close to winning, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
On the final stretch... I just wonder why 
I couldn't push harder...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Damn it... I'm so pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, gotta switch gears... I'm gonna get 
stronger at this summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A hero is someone who never, ever gives 
up...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright...! Guess I'll head out for a run 
right away...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to dilly-dally... I need 
to... train...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hey, Biko!! Look over here!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oryaaaah! Take thiiis!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WHOOOOSH! WHOO-WHOO-WHOOOOSH!!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaa-hah-hah-hah-hah! You're totally 
soaked~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, hero of justice? To 
think you couldn't even dodge an attack 
like this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bleh bleh bleeeh! If you're mad, just try 
and catch me~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wha... Hold on...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Kh! As a hero, I will stop you! Here I 
go—Pegasus Mach Stra—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Ahaha, it's kind of been a while 
since we did something like this.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ………… Windy-senpai…… could you perhaps be……

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Is it because I was moping around...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...What's up... heheh...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Senpai really isn't the bad person 
everyone says she is...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: She's not some violent coward...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugaaah, you're too slow! Why aren't you 
chasing after meee~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy-senpai! Instead of playing tag, 
wanna train together?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"If I remember right, there was a race 
during the training camp, wasn't there? 
You're running... in the GⅠ, right?"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Training can wait until later, it 
can!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Slacking off is not allowed! Hold it 
right theeeere!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The 'Japan Dirt Derby' is also coming up 
during the training camp. With training 
and racing, a scorching summer has begun!
